ensemble_deployment_language_probe.claim_scope: behavioral response only; not complete-reward accuracy

leakage_rule: Each CV test example is scored only by its own fold model.
target_scope: identifiable synthetic reward-conditioned language -> complete teacher reward; an upper-bound systems check, not a human local-language estimate

validity_gate.rule: Do not claim successful complete-reward inference unless the model beats both constant baselines on every required preference metric.
